title: f says /f/
parentNote: Today is /f/, the sound at the start of "fish". It is a stretchy one — top teeth on your bottom lip and blow — so you can hold it for as long as your child needs while they work out what comes next. The thing to listen for is a small "uh" sneaking on the end: "fuh-a-t" never turns into "fat", however fast you say it. Hold the fff instead and run it straight into the next sound. Three of today's words are boat words, so "mast" from earlier in the week comes back with company.

activities.mouthCue: Top teeth resting on your bottom lip, then blow. /fff/ — no voice in it, just air.
